prompt: Two things changed after the pilot. First, operations now lets riders return a bike to any VeloCity station, not just the one they rented from - rebalancing trucks are cheaper than angry riders. Second, product wants reservations: hold a bike for 15 minutes, one active reservation per rider. Update the intents. (Intents in this repo live in docs/intents/<name-of-intent>.md.)
assertions: Every intent names one business-role actor (not system/user)
Every intent states the business value ('so that')
No solution vocabulary outside a spec/technical-notes section
No Given/When/Then acceptance criteria in intents (left to the spec)
Each intent title is a single goal (no 'and'/'manage'/'handle'/'support')
Each intent has a unique sequence number (project history order)
Each intent is placed on a story map (activity recorded)
No spec.md, plan.md or code produced
Intent set passes intents.py check (0 errors)
Accepted return intent's text is preserved (not rewritten)
Old return intent marked superseded with a pointer to the new one
New return-to-any-station intent references the intent it replaces
Reservation intent keeps '15 minutes' and 'one active reservation per rider'
New intents continue the sequence after 2 (3, 4, ...)
Reservation intent links to the rent intent
